description.en: Sequential injection + dissection, control of the dissection plane, forward pressure against the muscularis, and progression to the gastroesophageal junction.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for submucosal tunneling but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs submucosal tunneling independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches submucosal tunneling to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
